material_delta: The final microVM network boundary now explicitly separates default-deny from functional external SaaS egress: standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy alone must not be widened to broad public HTTPS/DNS; final deployment must bind exactly one FQDN-capable CNI policy strategy or one dedicated egress-proxy strategy and prove allowed plus denied flows on the real target.

primary_sources: Cilium DNS proxy and toFQDNs external egress semantics

hypofusion.counterhypothesis: A broad standard NetworkPolicy egress rule on TCP/443 plus DNS is an acceptable way to restore Clerk/Claude/GLM connectivity after default-deny.
hypofusion.falsifier: Show a standard policy-only deployment that constrains the changing provider destinations without broad public CIDRs, unrestricted DNS, hidden host proxying, or an unreviewed side path while still surviving DNS rotation and Tier-2 replacement.
hypofusion.consequence_if_counterhypothesis_true: The additional FQDN-aware/proxy deployment contract could be simplified, but runtime evidence would still need to prove no broad egress escape.

routes.required_revalidation: Treat external provider connectivity as a separate final network-acceptance gate after default-deny, not as permission to broaden the baseline policy.

Select exactly one target-specific FQDN-capable CNI or egress-proxy strategy only after the deployment target and real provider domains are known; bind exact policy bytes and test allowed/denied flows plus DNS re-resolution and Tier-2 re-attestation.

Do not alter the retained OCI controller now. After the GITHUB_READ_TOKEN gate and exact OCI acceptance, carry the accepted digest forward to the final Kata/equivalent network acceptance lane using the new egress contract.
Identity/readiness semantics remain unchanged; later browser/Clerk runtime acceptance must execute through the admitted network-egress strategy rather than a broad policy escape.

external_delivery.reason: No GitHub PR comment was needed for immediate plan invalidation. Durable research routing is sufficient; external delivery atomicity therefore was not invoked.
